text: My seeker of the spirit world, please have a seat.
Elusive spirits of the netherworld, heed us now.
Talk to us, oh, shades of darkness.
Give us a gleam of your essence.
Give us a sign of your spiritual being.
Oh, restless souls, this poor gal seeks answers, answers to questions unknown.
Carnivage, the tea of pure evil, it had been contained, but now the pestilence is free to infect once more.
You are the chosen one. Only you can send it back. Find the dragon. It will show the way.
You don't know? Know what? You did it. You're not pulling my leg now, are you? No, I wouldn't do that.
